title: GKR M1 public test case v3
description:
Redacted public form of a test case. Question text, the oracle object, claims, citations, notes, authorship, review, salts, encrypted paths, and keys are excluded. Full test cases plus per-case salts live only in a plaintext_staging_bundle at a caller-supplied path outside the repository. That staging bundle is not sealed. Sealing a scoring suite requires a separate age-x25519-v1 externally encrypted artifact whose hash is bound by the suite manifest. Hash preimages follow profile ID gkr-m1-hash-profile-v1.

question_commitment_sha256 is SHA-256(salt_bytes || utf8(normalized_question)), where salt_bytes is a 32-byte secret that lives only in the plaintext staging bundle for that case. Concatenation is the raw salt bytes followed by the UTF-8 encoding of the gkr-m1-hash-profile-v1 normalized question: Unicode NFKC, every Unicode whitespace run to U+0020, trim, Unicode case-fold. The salt never appears in this public form.

question_commitment_sha256.description: SHA-256 under gkr-m1-hash-profile-v1 of salt_bytes || UTF-8(normalized_question).
